Amazon.text: Founded by Jeff Bezos in 1994, it started out as an online book marketplace.
Amazon.evidence: Founded in 1994 by Jeff Bezos in Bellevue, Washington, the company started as an online book marketplace that gradually expanded to include virtually all consumer products

Walmart.text: The largest private employer in the world, with 2.1 million employees.
Walmart.evidence: As of 2026, Walmart is the second-largest company by revenue globally and the largest private employer in the world, with 2.1 million employees.

State Grid Corporation of China.text: In 2023 it was reported to have 1.1 billion customers and 1.3 million employees.
State Grid Corporation of China.evidence: In 2023 it was reported as having 1.3 million employees, 1.1 billion customers and revenue equivalent to US$546 billion.

Saudi Aramco.text: It operates Ghawar and Safaniya, the world's largest onshore and offshore oil fields.
Saudi Aramco.evidence: Along the Eastern Province, Saudi Aramco most notably operates the Ghawar Field (the world's largest onshore oil field) and the Safaniya Field (the world's largest offshore oil field).

China National Petroleum Corporation.text: It was created in 1988, when the government disbanded the Ministry of Petroleum.
China National Petroleum Corporation.evidence: CNPC was created on 17 September 1988, when the government decided to create a state-owned company to handle all Petroleum activities in China and disbanded the Ministry of Petroleum.

China Petrochemical Corporation.text: Through 1997 it held 90% of China's oil refining capacity.
China Petrochemical Corporation.evidence: Through 1997, Sinopec held 90% of China' oil refining capacity.

Apple.text: It was founded in 1976 to market Steve Wozniak's Apple I computer.
Apple.evidence: Founded in 1976 as Apple Computer Company by Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne, ... The company was founded to market Wozniak's Apple I computer.

Alphabet.text: It was created in 2015 through a restructuring of Google, becoming Google's parent company.
Alphabet.evidence: It was created through a restructuring of Google on October 2, 2015, and became the parent holding company of Google and several former Google subsidiaries.

UnitedHealth Group.text: It began in 1974 as Charter Med, processing claims for doctors in Minnesota.
UnitedHealth Group.evidence: UnitedHealth Group originated in late 1974, when Minnesota-based Charter Med Incorporated was founded by Richard Taylor Burke together with a group of physicians and healthcare professionals. It originally processed claims for doctors at the Hennepin County Medical Society.

Berkshire Hathaway.text: Once a textile maker, it now has the highest per-share price of any public company.
Berkshire Hathaway.evidence: Originally a textile manufacturer, the company transitioned into a conglomerate starting in 1965 ... Its class A shares have the highest per-share price of any public company in the world, reaching $700,000 in August 2024,
